lastCompletedStory.title: Surface failed plan-approval branch creation instead of silently entering 'implementing'

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-319) was the only story in this PRD; it is now complete. makePlanApprovalResolverDeps.proceedBranchFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts) now returns boolean (true only when git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD confirms the derived cam/* branch is HEAD after the checkout-B/add/commit sequence), and logs a durable 'plan-approval-branch-failed' event (new WorkerEventKind in src/supervisor/events.ts, detail typed via the existing Record<string, unknown> WorkerEventDetail fallback rather than a dedicated interface) on: derive-branch-name-null, head-mismatch, or any caught git error. makePlanApprovalResolver's approve arm (src/supervisor/plan-approval-gate.ts) now only returns 'implementing' when proceedBranchFn() returns true; on false it calls notifyFn with a surfacing line and fails safe to 'idle', mirroring the reject/default arms. pollAndResolveGate (src/supervisor/gate.ts) was intentionally left untouched (AC5). File-size ceilings raised: src/commands/sidecar.ts 3265->3302, src/supervisor/events.ts 732->739 (both dated + tracker-ref'd in scripts/file-size-budget.json's _ref).
